examples.arabic: احمد فتح الكيس و لقى ملح
examples.english: Ahmad opened the bag and found salt.
examples.transliteration: Ahmed fatah el kees wa laka malh

examples.arabic: الصبح جار فتح باب بيته وريحة اكل سخن طلعت
examples.english: In the morning, a neighbor opened his house door, and the smell of hot food came out.
examples.transliteration: El sobh gaar fataḥ baab beito w reeḥet akl sokhn tele3et.
